subject: Way to view syntax inputted from the output

messages.author: 60b2ea04e1e4d17d
messages.subject: Way to view syntax inputted from the output
parts:
Hi, I have a quick question. I’m running the ggir syntax in r studios for accelerometer data for my PhD. I have a number of participants in Perth and some in Sydney. It’s very confusing. I wondered if there was a way I could quickly check the syntax I ran from looking at the outputs to confirm I edited the syntax to put the right country for each section? With the results do any of the files contain the parameters (syntax) I inputted? I’ve not found this so far. Any help with this would be appreciated. I know r studios has a history section but it is kind of confusing as sometimes I ran something then realised I put the wrong country so I re ran it. Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks
Rachel

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Way to view syntax inputted from the output
parts:
Hi Rachel,
Does the calendar_date variable in the part2 not give away the timezone?
I would expect Perth times to end with +0800 and Sydney times to end with +1000?
Best, Vincent
